understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +; the level and game are won only when all goals are occupied simultaneously.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces are selected and moved by clicking target positions or using directional movement actions. Movement is constrained by walls and obstacles; blocked moves leave the piece in place. Pieces can be pushed when movement interacts with obstacles or other pieces, and positions must be navigated carefully rather than repeatedly clicking inaccessible targets.
